title: The additive signed fibre complex and its homotopies
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $A,B:C\to\mathrm{Ab}$ be additive functors and let $r:A\Rightarrow B$ be natural. Construct an additive functor $F$ on integer cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $F(I)^n=A(I^n)\times B(I^{n-1})$, $D(a,b)=(A(d)a,r(a)-B(d)b)$ and diagonal maps. A homotopy $H$ induces the homotopy $(A(H),-B(H))$. If $I^n=0$ for every $n<N$, then $F(I)^n=0$ for every $n<N$.

source.place: Tags 014E/014F; signed two-term refinement in the proof of lem-amb-signed-fibre-triangulated.

proof.text: Construct the differential and the diagonal maps explicitly. The two squares of differentials vanish by functoriality, while naturality of r cancels the mixed terms. Naturality also proves the chain-map equations. Check identities, composition and addition in each coordinate.

Construct the homotopy with second coordinate -B(H). Expanding D h+h D cancels its mixed r-terms by naturality and leaves A(f-g),B(f-g). For a lower bound N, additive functors preserve zero objects and n<N implies n-1<N, so both coordinates vanish.
